messages:
alex: Heads-up: launching a new OSS reference app next Wed (edge-serve-refapp). Need launch post, bench narrative for infra folks, 30-min webinar, and inbound routing for demo signups/docs. :rocket:

maya: Great. I can own social + email. Would like two headline angles: bench-first and product-CTA.

jordan: Drafts: 1) 'Edge-Serve RefApp: 4x throughput, 1/3 the cost for short-context inference' 2) 'Ship LLMs at the edge  Try the refapp and demo'. Social snippet below.

jordan: ```Meet Edge-Serve RefApp  production-minded templates, perf benches, and a hands-on demo. Join the webinar: https://rwd.co/refapp-webinar #opensource #inference```

sam: Webinar plan (30m): 10m demo, 10m bench walkthrough, 5m integration patterns, 5m Q&A. I can host if bench owner presents numbers. Need one eng for demo fallback.

lee: Bench highlights to include: p99=~48ms on A100 fp16 for 512 tokens, steady-state throughput ~240 tok/s (batch x4), cost ~ $0.0009/token. I'll validate and provide methodology.

alex: @lee own bench; @maya social+email; @sam host+rehearse; @jordan blog draft. I'll handle release notes and routing ticket.

maya: Timeline: blog draft Mon EOD, social+email Tue AM, reg page Tue afternoon, rehearsal Tue 5pm.

ops-bot: marketing-publish workflow created  PR #412 for scheduled publish.

lee: Routing ask: tag demo signups with CRM "refapp-edge-2026" and route eng leads to eng-sales. Proposed mapping: demo -> growth demo-flow, bench inquiries -> eng-sales, press -> comms.

alex: Confirmed. I'll add UTM params + hidden "bench_interest" field to form and open the routing ticket.

jordan: Blog outline: 1) why; 2) what's included; 3) benchmarks + methodology; 4) how to run; 5) webinar CTA + repo link. Draft will land in the doc.

maya: Can we include a one-line partner quote top fold? Better CTR.

lee: I can fetch a POC quote by Mon AM.

alex: Risks: live demo flakiness and bench questions. Plan: rehearsal + pre-recorded fallback, publish raw bench scripts as appendix.

sam: Rehearsal Tue 5pm PT. I'll prep fallback clip.

maya: I'll A/B test two subject lines: 'New: Edge-Serve RefApp + live demo' and 'Benchmark: 4x throughput for edge inference  try the refapp'.

alex: Next steps recap: jordan blog Mon EOD, maya social/email Tue AM, lee bench + quote Mon AM, sam host + rehearse Tue 5pm, alex routing + PR. Quick sync Mon 10am. :white_check_mark:
